hf/minimax-h3.note: weights and prompt guides. A new filename here is how Regenerate-2K, an official low-step checkpoint or a rewritten guide will first appear - usually days before anyone writes about it.

gh/minimax-h3.note: reference implementation, plus the consolidated prompt Skill the team said in their AMA they keep iterating on. Our enrichment prompt is built from these guides.

gh/comfyui.note: the image pins a version. A release is the trigger to re-test the pinned node set, not to bump blindly.

gh/workflow-templates.note: the official H3 graphs. A changed blob means the reference wiring moved.

gh/sageattention.note: our wheel is compiled from this main branch. A moved head means the wheel we ship is stale.

gh/sageattention-wheels.note: third-party prebuilt wheels. Windows only today - a linux asset appearing here would retire our own build workflow.

gh/h3-motion-context.note: clip chaining past the 8 s ceiling. Patches ComfyUI internals, so its releases matter more than most - only one such pack can own those patches at a time.

gh/h3-turbo.note: the step-distillation LoRA and its sampler. The AMA confirmed no OFFICIAL low-step checkpoint exists, so this pack is the only game in town and its quality trade-offs are ours.

pins/pod-comfyui-h3.note: how far each pinned custom node has drifted from upstream. Read from the Dockerfile that actually builds the image, never copied here - a second list would drift from the first invisibly.

gh/h3-spectrum.note: sampler-level accelerator: forecasts steps instead of running the transformer, ~45% fewer evaluations on a 20-step Euler run. A different lever from SageAttention, which makes each evaluation cheaper - the two compose. Moves fast and patches ComfyUI internals, like Motion Context, and only one such pack can own them at a time.

reddit/sd-h3.note: where node packs and breaking changes get announced first. Quoted phrase on purpose: a bare H3 matches turtles.

reddit/any-h3.note: site-wide, to catch subreddits we have not thought of.
